name: University Valley, Quartermain Mountains, McMurdo Dry Valleys (Antarctica)
research_extent: Valley floor around the met/ground-temperature station cluster (1661-1697 m a.s.l.); polygon outline NOT obtained
boundary_basis: Marinova 2022 p.145 (valley 77°52'S 160°45'E, ~1700 m) and p.146 (stations 77°51.729'S 160°42.606'E, 1661-1697 m); boundary = station cluster, not a surveyed polygon
available_data: Air T/RH 1.2 m, wind 1.08 m, ground T at surface/10/42/49 cm, 2009-12 to 2013-01 (Marinova Table II p.153); ice-table depth 10-60 cm (Heldmann 2013 abstract)
testable_physical_processes: Dry cover over ice-cemented ground: how ice-table depth, cover and seasonal heating couple; sublimation/vapour exchange; whether a thermal signal is separable from cover
main_environment_differences: Latitude 77.9S vs 52.75N; measured Earth MAAT -23.4 degC is not comparable with model-time-adjusted, coarse-bin MCS context (quantity/QA not independently reprocessed; not local ground temperature). Atmosphere, pressure, dust and insolation differ. W-station ice-cemented interface is 42 cm; approximately 15 cm is the 0 degC active layer, not total dry-cover thickness. Actual MS-02 ice depth remains unknown.
disposition_reason: Retained for the specifically documented W-station ice-cemented interface and multi-depth seasonal thermal response. This is an identifiability/method reference; independently separating ice from local cover/material/boundary effects has not been demonstrated. Do not reuse deprecated H2/H3 radar-chain claims.
cannot_extrapolate: Not a proof that MS-02 has ice; no extrapolation of 42 cm ice-table depth, temperatures or water activity to MS-02
next_verification_step: Link raw W-station channels to serial/deployment metadata and preserve unresolved original clock/coordinate issues; obtain co-located density, heat capacity, conductivity and an independent ice profile plus matched ice-free/boundary controls before a unique ice or blind-accuracy claim. Table II/Fig.6 have been read; their publication summaries are not the raw series.

name: Middle Beacon Valley, Quartermain Mountains (Antarctica)
research_extent: Original middle/central Beacon Valley records retain their separate, incompletely located scopes. A limited Liu2018 thermal/material subcase is located at 77deg49S,160deg39E; shallow sensors near a ~30 cm dry-cover/ice interface and an adjacent-polygon deep borehole are separate supports. No valley-wide surveyed boundary has been obtained.
boundary_basis: Keep earlier Heldmann2013/Kowalewski2006/McKay2009/Bannister2007 records separate. Added primary Liu2018 sections2-3.3/Table1/Fig2 locates only its thermal subcase (77deg49S160deg39E); the adjacent deep borehole is not the same vertical column.
available_data: Historical abstract-level depth/sublimation records remain separately sourced in evidence.csv. Liu2018 primary sections2-3.3/Table1/Fig2 now read: shallow temperatures, ~30 cm cover/interface, laboratory heat capacity, semiempirical conductivity, adjacent-polygon deep borehole. Original Liu raw time series has not been acquired; no independent rerun or generic valley-wide promotion.
testable_physical_processes: Massive buried ice beneath thin dry cover; sublimation-rate and humidity/temperature sensitivity of buried ice; snow recurrence control on ice depth; geophysical detection of massive vs cemented ice
main_environment_differences: Polar latitude/climate/pressure mismatch with MS-02; massive-ice versus ice-cemented distinction is site-specific. Liu2018 is a located primary-literature thermal/material subcase, while older 10-60 cm and 40-80 cm ranges remain different sites/definitions and are not reconciled. Missing raw series prevents independent time-series reanalysis.
disposition: 待補證據（原整體候選）；Liu2018具名熱學/材料子案例可作限定文獻參照
disposition_reason: The older whole-valley candidate is not upgraded. Latest primary-source review establishes a located ~30 cm interface/material thermal subcase (Liu2018); laboratory heat capacity and semiempirical conductivity are distinguished. Raw observations and co-located boundary/material controls remain missing.
cannot_extrapolate: Sublimation of 0.017 mm over 6 weeks and 40-80 cm till depth are Beacon Valley values; Bannister 100 m depth is not peer-reviewed and not cross-checked
next_verification_step: Acquire the original Liu2018 raw thermal series and sensor/depth/spatial metadata before independent reanalysis; preserve its adjacent deep borehole as a separate support. Resolve older study-specific depth ranges with original footprints, not a valley-name join.

name: Adventdalen, central Spitsbergen, Svalbard (Norway)
research_extent: Group of separate Adventdalen evidence footprints, not a single validated site. Scalar coordinates78.1722N16.0613E retain the ADE historical anchor (FP-03); retained aeolian-cover/syngenetic-ice subprocess is CS-1 at78.201N15.840E (FP-01), about5.97km away. HRSC-AX8-site bounding box and unlocated WISDOM polygon-trough lines remain separate supports; no overlap or same-site truth assumed.
boundary_basis: Hauber 2011 p.113 (valley dimensions, no coordinates); Rotem 2023 (ADE 78.1722°N 16.0613°E, 23 m a.s.l.; valley centre 78.110°N 16.180°E); PANGAEA 921087 site table (bounding box and 8 site coordinates, CC BY 4.0)
available_data: Svalbard Airport climate 1912-1993 (Hauber Table 1 p.114); Adventdalen 'Polygons' MAAT -5.8 °C (Rotem 2023); HRSC-AX DEMs 0.5-1 m (Hauber pp.112-113); WISDOM GPR Mar 2022 (Brighi 2025); loess OSL record (Rasmussen 2023); PANGAEA polygon geomorphometry dataset (site table read; polygon values are in zip files that could not be downloaded); UNISCALM CALM active-layer series on a loess terrace (since 2000; AGU 2016 abstract)
testable_physical_processes: Retain CS-1 aeolian-silt accumulation and syngenetic-ice co-evolution as a specific measured core subprocess. ADE chemistry/structure and Hauber polygon geometry are separate references. WISDOM polygon-trough radar remains general-method context without located same-line independent ice truth; no combined cover-plus-radar validation chain.
main_environment_differences: Latitude 78°N; thicker, wetter, vegetated-valley setting not described in what I read; MAAT -5.8 °C; saline/epigenetic permafrost part (Rotem); polygons 10-20 m vs Mars example 5-10 m (Hauber Fig 4)
disposition: 降為一般方法參照 (CS-1 loess core retained only as a process analog of aeolian cover + syngenetic ice; the radar link is 證據不足)
disposition_reason: Fourth-round audit (2026-11-15): the three evidence sets are NOT co-located. Loess core CS-1 (78.201N 15.840E) is ~6.0 km from the ADE borehole (78.1722N 16.0613E); the WISDOM polygon-trough survey (March 2022) has no stated coordinates and no independent ice truth in the abstract (its stated 3D ground truth is for a glacier ice cave, a different terrain). Only CS-1 has a measured ice profile under a dated aeolian cover; Rasmussen's 0.35 cm/yr is an abstract-level maximum (body: >0.3 cm/yr in one ~150-yr phase; mostly 0.05-0.25), and Rotem's 60-100 cm active layer is a cited general range
cannot_extrapolate: Svalbard loess accumulation rates and active-layer depth cannot be transferred to Mars dust deposition or MS-02 cover thickness; GPR ε values are Earth-material model inputs; MS-02 dust optical depth (column, 9.3 µm) is not a surface accumulation rate; no Adventdalen result shows ice detection beneath an aeolian cover at one place
next_verification_step: CS-1 coring date is resolved: September2019; August2022 exposure is ~20 m NE. Wendt core coordinates/values have been acquired separately and cannot be joined to unlocated WISDOM lines. Obtain actual WISDOM line geometry and same-line independent ice observations before overlap/truth claims; keep CALM and older active-layer periods separate.

name: Haughton River Valley, Haughton impact structure, Devon Island, Nunavut (Canada)
research_extent: Keep original Haughton River Valley nine-LiDAR-grid scope separate. A limited Thomson2012 plateau GPR/core subcase is at 75.368333N,-89.525833E with a 3 m line and a core at its 1.5 m CMP focus; approximately 0.9 m wet overburden was excavated. Do not merge this line with river/gully or 2003 base-camp evidence by place name.
boundary_basis: Original scalar anchor75.37N,-89.53E and nine-grid extent remain Andres2020 Table3.1/Fig1.8 p20 (UTM16N grids; impact-structure centre is different). Separate Thomson2012 primary DOI10.1029/2012JE004053 sections2.3,3.1-3.3 locates plateau subcase75deg22min06secN89deg31min33secW (FP-12):3m line, core at1.5m CMPfocus, ~0.9m overburden excavated. This point anchor is not a full line polygon or an automatic match to Andres/2003 footprints.
available_data: Original Andres2020 LiDAR/thaw-depth and Nieto2003 GPR/seismic records retain their own footprints. Added primary Thomson2012 sections2.3,3.1-3.3: 450 MHz GPR on a 3 m line and a ~1 m core, diameter0.10m, at CMP focus1.5m after ~0.9m overburden excavation. Raw radar/core profiles are not acquired; no whole-valley ice quantity or ground-temperature series.
testable_physical_processes: Polar-desert patterned-ground geometry (polygons, stripes, stone circles) and active-layer thaw depth at LiDAR scale; Arcadia-class comparison only via Hibbard thesis (abstract)
main_environment_differences: Impact structure setting at 75°N, MAAT ~-15 to -16 °C; ground-ice content (10-20%) is a Canadian High Arctic generality, not Haughton data; Axel Heiberg GPR/ice-wedge volume is a different site; author states nine grids in a very small locale may not generalise (p.115)
disposition: 待補證據（原河谷候選）；Thomson2012挖除覆土後同線GPR/岩芯子案例可作限定方法參照
disposition_reason: Original river-valley candidate is not upgraded. A distinct primary study supplies independent core evidence at one point on a 3 m GPR line, but the wet active layer had been excavated. It does not validate intact aeolian-cover detection, spatially exhaustive ground truth or orbital SHARAD, and Table1 aggregate material classes do not give this point a local ice fraction.
cannot_extrapolate: Thaw depth (0.52-0.67 m, July 2019) and GPR permafrost-top depth are snapshots from different sites in the valley; the 10-20% ice content must not be applied to Haughton or MS-02
next_verification_step: Acquire original Thomson2012 GPR/core profiles, field date, calibration and exact spatial linkage; retain core location and excavated-cover state. Independent undisturbed-cover controls are required for that broader use. Do not substitute Canadian High Arctic ice percentages or other sites.
